answer: Like grains settling across a shifting dune, our network anchors consensus in an interconnected mycelium of cryptographic trust. When an adversary unleashes identity clones, each recursive peer validation traces a deepening computational spiral. An attacker faces superlinear staking costs proportional to graph connectivity, starving counterfeit nodes just as a solitary raven starves in barren sands. Genuine agency thrives only through mutual entanglement.
